title: Hook
line: …you do not get enough people to get started with the consultation.
visual: NOT ENOUGH PEOPLE ON YOUR (justified white kicker) / 1:1 CALLS. (yellow) + blue brush underline. Halftone ghost 1:1 behind the speaker's head.
motion: Kicker on frame 1, headline blur-scales in at 0.45s; underline paints on 'enough people' with a punch-in.

title: Series tile
line: Welcome to Coach Meet Business Series…
visual: Paper tile ep. 06 — same series tile.
motion: 06 rises, words land on the spoken word, tile wipes up.

title: 1 crore
line: …what it takes to build a one crore coaching business.
visual: WHAT IT TAKES TO BUILD A / ₹1 CRORE / coaching business.
motion: Word-by-word kicker; ₹1 CRORE on 'one crore'; punch-in.

title: Your 1:1 calls
line: …a much more personalized way… the higher level of transformation…
visual: New diagram, behind the speaker: YOUR 1:1 CALLS — a row of seven empty call slots (hand-drawn shimmer). Serif: personalized. → a higher transformation.
motion: Slots pop in one by one on 'consultation'; 'personalized.' on 'personalized'; the arrow line on 'higher level'.

title: Not enough people
line: …not able to get the right kind of people… not enough people on one on one consultation.
visual: Same row: one slot holds a blue person, six stay empty. Serif: not enough people.
motion: One person pops in on 'right kind of people'; the empty slots flash blue on 'enough people'; punch-in.

title: Your approach
line: …not able to understand what is your approach to solve the problem.
visual: THEY DON'T UNDERSTAND (white) / your approach. (big yellow serif). Ghost word APPROACH behind the speaker's head.
motion: Kicker words on 'not… understand'; serif blur-scales in on 'your approach' with a push-in.

title: They ask
line: …is this the best mechanism…? Is it the right way of solving the problem that I have?
visual: Label-column: THEY ASK | is this the best mechanism? / is this the right way for my problem? — each with a blue ?.
motion: Rule draws on 'qualify'; each question row arrives on its spoken question; the ? marks pop.

title: The example
line: …a person who wants to reverse his diabetes. What is the way he is looking to solve…
visual: FOR EXAMPLE | wants to reverse diabetes (outline) / ASK | which way will he take? (serif).
motion: Rows arrive on 'reverse his diabetes' and 'the way'.

title: B-roll: three roads
line: Is it through meditation? Is it through diet? Is it through exercise?
visual: Full-screen cutaway, paper-textured page: REVERSE DIABETES at the bottom, three hand-painted roads branching up to MEDITATION / DIET / EXERCISE. Yellow serif: which approach?
motion: Page slides up; each road paints on as each is named, a blue dot lands at the end and its label blurs in; 'which approach?' on 'approach'; page slides away.

title: The domino chain
line: If you're not clear with your approach, your offer is unclear… you will not attract the right kind of people…
visual: New metaphor, behind the speaker: three line-art dominoes — APPROACH → OFFER (label turns yellow) → RIGHT PEOPLE. Kicker: IF THE APPROACH ISN'T CLEAR.
motion: Dominoes stand up; APPROACH tips on 'approach', knocks OFFER on 'unclear', RIGHT PEOPLE falls flat (bounce) on 'attract the right kind of people'; push-in.

title: Always a hassle
line: It will always be a hassle.
visual: The fallen chain stays; serif headline: it will always be a hassle.
motion: Kicker swaps for the serif line on 'hassle' with a quick punch.

title: Make both clear
line: …very clear with your approach, making your offer clear in front of them…
visual: MAKE BOTH CLEAR / APPROACH (blue pill) → OFFER (yellow pill).
motion: APPROACH pops on 'approach', arrow draws, OFFER pops on 'offer' (push-in).

title: They qualify themselves
line: …so that they can qualify themselves and get started walking with you deeper…
visual: Callback: THEY QUALIFY | the same two questions now ticked (blue checks). Yellow serif: they qualify themselves.
motion: Checks draw on 'qualify themselves'; the serif line lands on 'themselves'.

title: Every slot fills
line: And that is where you give them the higher degree of transformation.
visual: Callback of the 1:1 slots: all seven filled with people, turning yellow. Yellow serif: a higher transformation.
motion: People pop into every slot one by one; on 'higher' they all turn yellow; serif lands on 'transformation'.

title: CTA
line: …your offer in the comment section and I'll help you improve your offer for free.
visual: COMMENT YOUR / O F F E R key-caps / & I'll help you improve it, for free. Ghost word OFFER behind the speaker's head.
motion: Keys drop in one by one on 'offer'; serif line on 'help'.
